execution_policy.drawdown: peak-to-trough cash-equivalent value sampled on hourly closes
execution_policy.fill_model: full quantity at the next hourly open plus specified additional delay
execution_policy.terminal_valuation: cash plus sell proceeds after spread, slippage, fee and minimum

plan.selection: Beat both baselines at every cost and fold with drawdown at most 10%; rank by worst net return, worst drawdown, then strategy id.
